list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Matched price-table entry (or other). The requested and routed model names are in the per-call tables below.

list.name: profile
list.label: Profile
list.description: Guardrail profile the call ran under.

list.name: user
list.label: User regex
list.description: Regex over user.id (uid or SID), the account name or the directory principal (case-insensitive). Narrows every Loki panel on this board to records that carry that user. Prometheus metric panels have no per-user label and stay fleet-wide.

panels.title: Cost in range (USD)
panels.description: Sum of defenseclaw.model.cost over the range. Calls whose cost is unknown add nothing, so this is a floor; see the absent-cost share beside it.

targets.expr: sum(((increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range))

panels.title: Tokens in range
panels.description: Disjoint token counts (uncached input, cache read, cache creation, output without reasoning, reasoning) summed over the range.

targets.expr: sum(((increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range))

panels.title: Cache-read share of prompt tokens
panels.description: cache_read / (input + cache_read + cache_creation). Higher means more of the prompt was served from the provider cache.

targets.expr: sum(((increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="cache_read"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="cache_read"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="cache_read"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="cache_read"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="cache_read"} offset $__range)) / sum(((increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_creation"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_creation"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_creation"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_creation"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_creation"} offset $__range))

panels.title: Reasoning share of output tokens
panels.description: reasoning / (output + reasoning). Output is counted without reasoning tokens, so the two are disjoint.

targets.expr: sum(((increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="reasoning"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="reasoning"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="reasoning"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="reasoning"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="reasoning"} offset $__range)) / sum(((increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"output|reasoning"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"output|reasoning"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"output|reasoning"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"output|reasoning"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"output|reasoning"} offset $__range))

panels.title: Calls with absent cost (share)
panels.description: Share of model.usage records with cost.basis none: no price entry matched or usage was missing. From logs, so it follows the Connector and User boxes.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_cost_basis="none" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") [$__range]))

panels.title: Usage records dropped
panels.description: defenseclaw.tokenomics.dropped: usage records discarded because the bounded queue was full. Anything above zero means the cost and token counters undercount.

targets.expr: sum(((increase(defenseclaw_tokenomics_dropped_total[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_tokenomics_dropped_total[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_tokenomics_dropped_total offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_tokenomics_dropped_total[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_tokenomics_dropped_total offset $__range))

panels.title: Cost over time (USD per interval)
panels.description: Increase of defenseclaw.model.cost per rate interval, all selected series together.

targets.expr: sum(increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tokens by kind
panels.description: Increase of defenseclaw.model.tokens per rate interval by kind. Kinds are disjoint, so the stack is the real total.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cost by model
panels.description: Cost by matched price-table entry. other means the model is not in the price table.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cost by route decision
panels.description: Cost by the router decision for the call.

targets.expr: sum by (route_decision) (increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cost by connector
panels.description: Cost by the agent connector that made the call.

targets.expr: sum by (connector) (increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cost by guardrail profile
panels.description: Cost by the guardrail profile in force for the call.

targets.expr: sum by (profile) (increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cost by call role (range)
panels.description: Agent calls, guardrail judge calls and any other call role over the range.

targets.expr: sum by (call_role) (((increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range))

panels.title: Tokens by model (range)
panels.description: All token kinds by matched price-table entry over the range.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (((increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range))

panels.title: Cache-read share of prompt tokens over time
panels.description: cache_read / (input + cache_read + cache_creation) per rate interval.

targets.expr: sum(increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="cache_read"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"input|cache_read|cache_creation"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Reasoning share of output tokens over time
panels.description: reasoning / (output + reasoning) per rate interval.

targets.expr: sum(increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind="reasoning"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision",kind=~"output|reasoning"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Calls with absent cost over time (share)
panels.description: model.usage records with cost.basis none divided by all model.usage records, per interval.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_cost_basis="none" [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") [$__auto]))

panels.title: Models with absent cost
panels.description: Routed (selected) model of calls with cost.basis none: the models to add to observability.pricing.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_cost_basis="none" | label_format model="{{if .body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{.body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Routed vs requested model
panels.description: What the agent asked for (gen_ai.request.model) against what the router sent the call to (defenseclaw.model.selected), with call count and known cost. From model.usage logs.

targets.expr: topk(50, sum by (requested, selected, provider, decision) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | label_format requested="{{if .body_gen_ai_request_model}}{{.body_gen_ai_request_model}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", selected="{{if .body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{.body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", provider="{{if .body_gen_ai_provider_name}}{{.body_gen_ai_provider_name}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", decision="{{if .body_defenseclaw_route_decision}}{{.body_defenseclaw_route_decision}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__range])))

topk(50, sum by (requested, selected, provider, decision) (sum_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_cost_usd!="" | label_format requested="{{if .body_gen_ai_request_model}}{{.body_gen_ai_request_model}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", selected="{{if .body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{.body_defenseclaw_model_selected}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", provider="{{if .body_gen_ai_provider_name}}{{.body_gen_ai_provider_name}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", decision="{{if .body_defenseclaw_route_decision}}{{.body_defenseclaw_route_decision}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" | unwrap body_defenseclaw_cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top users by cost
panels.description: Known cost and calls per user from model.usage logs. Users exist only in logs, never as metric labels; the User box narrows this table.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (user) (sum_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_cost_usd!="" | label_format user="{{if .body_defenseclaw_user_name}}{{.body_defenseclaw_user_name}}{{else if .body_user_id}}{{.body_user_id}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" | unwrap body_defenseclaw_cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range])))

topk(20, sum by (user) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | label_format user="{{if .body_defenseclaw_user_name}}{{.body_defenseclaw_user_name}}{{else if .body_user_id}}{{.body_user_id}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Cost by provider
panels.description: Cost by the provider the call was sent to (the selected provider after routing).

targets.expr: sum by (provider) (increase(defenseclaw_model_cost_USD_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tokens by connector (range)
panels.description: All token kinds by the agent connector that made the call, over the range.

targets.expr: sum by (connector) (((increase(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) * 0)) and defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range) or (last_over_time(defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"}[$__range]) unless defenseclaw_model_tokens_total{connector=~"$connector",model=~"$model",profile=~"$profile",route_decision=~"$route_decision"} offset $__range))

panels.title: Calls with unknown cost (count)
panels.description: Number of model.usage records with cost.basis none in the range: no price entry matched or the provider reported no usage. Unknown cost is never counted as zero.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_cost_basis="none" [$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Own usage and all usage
panels.description: Who sees what.

options.content:
**All usage.** Metrics carry no user or group, by design, so every panel on this dashboard shows the whole gateway to whoever can open Grafana. The table Top users by cost reads `model.usage` logs and is an administrator view.

**Own usage.** A person sees only their own usage from the gateway: `GET /usage` (own rows only on a managed host), the own-status answer on managed Windows, and `defenseclaw setup tokenomics --status`. Group rollups are administrator-only and never leave the endpoint.

panels.title: Dropped usage records
panels.description: Increase of defenseclaw.tokenomics.dropped per rate interval.

targets.expr: sum(increase(defenseclaw_tokenomics_dropped_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Partial usage records (share)
panels.description: Share of model.usage records flagged defenseclaw.usage.partial, for example a stream cut before the final usage frame. From logs.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") | body_defenseclaw_usage_partial="true" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="model.usage" | connector=~"$connector" | (body_user_id=~"$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_name=~"(?i)$user" or body_defenseclaw_user_principal=~"(?i)$user") [$__range]))

title: DefenseClaw — Tokenomics
description: Model cost and tokens: cost over time and by model, route, connector and profile, tokens by kind, cache-read and reasoning shares, calls with absent cost, routed against requested model, top users by cost and dropped usage records. Metrics carry no user label; per-user and per-call panels read model.usage logs.
